notes.title: The Last of Waifus is in Early Access with 30% OFF!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35694047/9ac1a4513830b5df6e323527f0e3081db303f9eb.png[/img]


[b]It's been a long time[/b] since The Last of Waifus was firstly shaped into a game. We worked hard on turning all our dreams into the actual game for you, however The Last of Waifus is not yet how we imagined it to be.

We want to do our game better and focus on this project for at least a month or so more. So do not worry, [b]it is not the final version[/b] of The Last of Waifus!

We hope to hear both your [b]feedback and suggestions[/b]. We are waiting for your ideas!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359650/The_Last_of_Waifus/

[h1]Also, the game features a FREE Nudity DLC:[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1365990/The_Last_of_Waifus__Nudity_DLC_18/

[h2]We wish you the best gaming![/h2]

[h2]Cheers,
Konnichiwa Games[/h2]
